snippet_primary: "I provided full proof that I was blocked by the seller within the refund period, yet Gumroad kept sending automated AI replies saying \"contact the seller.\" Now, they simply ignore my emails — not even a single human response. This platform protects scammers, not creators or customers. I've already reported this to FTC and my local bank."
